description: Graph rules: find_graph_violations(flow, check_values, base). A case gives `flow` (or `flow_json`, JSON text whose numbers matter), an optional `base` (the stored graph a write replaces) and `check_values` (default true), and the violations in order, each with its code, path, message, resolution and edge_id, or the `error` the check raises. Each case names the rule it checks in `rule`; README.md lists the rules. The expected outputs are reviewed data that every engine must meet.
